description: Current local time, UTC offset, daylight saving and time difference for a place, computed now from the IANA Time Zone Database. place accepts a country (name in English or Korean, or ISO code), a capital, an IANA zone (America/New_York) or a big city that names a zone (New York, Los Angeles, Sydney). Differences are from Seoul unless compare_to is given. Countries with several time zones list each offset group. Without place: Seoul and 16 major capitals.

compare_to.description: Reference place for the difference (default Seoul)

place.description: e.g. Japan, 미국, Paris, America/Chicago, New York

name: world_time
title: World time and time differences
